authorities.paraphrase: An attorney using generative AI must take reasonable steps to verify its output, including all case and statutory citations.

A brief, pleading, motion or other paper filed in any court must not contain any citation that the responsible attorney has not personally verified. This covers any citation, not only cases and statutes.

Approved Sept. 30, 2026. No urgency clause. Operative Jan. 1, 2027. Adds Bus. & Prof. Code § 6068.1, amends Code Civ. Proc. § 128.7, adds Code Civ. Proc. §§ 180 and 1282.1, and amends Bus. & Prof. Code § 6173.
